Subject: Private sandbox for regulated analysis + renewal timing

Laura —

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. We walked the execs through the performance numbers and they asked if we can stand up a private sandbox environment (isolated VPC + separate clusters) for a new regulated analytics workload. Key asks:

- Dedicated VPC in us-west1 with strict network isolation
- Two additional inference clusters (prod-like sizing) to mirror our production capacity for validation
- Short-term retention (30 days) for the sandbox logs but separate audit bucket
- Ability to accelerate renewal to align the sandbox provisioning with our Q1 validation window (goal: cutover by 2027-01-20)

We realize this may change up the renewal cadence and pricing. Can you summarize the cost delta and how quickly Redwood can provision? Also loop in any legal/PO needs — Maya on procurement will manage paperwork.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Head of Data Platforms
Biogenix

Hi Sanjay —

Really appreciate the clear asks. We can absolutely do an isolated sandbox VPC + two dedicated clusters and line up the cutover for the week of 2027-01-17. Quick notes and next steps:

- Provisioning lead time: ~3–4 weeks once contracts are signed and the PO is issued.
- Pricing: there are two components — the dedicated cluster add-on (monthly committed capacity for the clusters) and an environment carveout (one-time setup fee for the sandbox VPC, audit bucket, and KMS binding). I will attach a draft pricing schedule.
- Term alignment options: we can either (A) accelerate the renewal start date for the sandbox capacity to 2027-01-01 with a 12-month commitment (pro-rate the remainder of your existing term), or (B) add a 3–6 month temporary addendum that sunsets at your next renewal (lower effective price, shorter commitment).

Marissa — can you prepare the typical sandbox SOW and an accelerated term worksheet?
Kimberly — need an ops/technical validation checklist (network ACLs, KMS, audit buckets, standby cluster spin policy).
Dylan — please flag any capacity or oversubscription risks for us-west1 during Jan.

Sanjay — I’ll follow up with a formal SOW + ballpark pricing by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Sanjay / team —

Quick technical confirmations from our side:

- Network: we will provision a VPC with strict route tables and managed NATs. We can implement a dedicated peering path and customer-managed firewall rules.
- KMS: customer-managed key is preferred for audit; legal should sign the KMS binding addendum.
- Clusters: two additional clusters will be the same SKU mix as your production environment (NVIDIA A100 equivalent). We recommend enabling prefix KV caching for the sandbox to reduce validation token costs.
- Capacity: Jan is a medium-demand window for us-west1. I recommend we mark these clusters as reserved capacity to guarantee start-of-week availability. That requires a short-term commit (see Marissa’s pricing).

I’ll prepare the ops checklist and a short validation runbook that we can use for the cutover smoke tests.

—Kimberly
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Maya —

Great ; thank you. Answers inline below and next steps after that: 

1) DocuSign: I will send the SOW as a DocuSign envelope this afternoon. It will be versioned as SOW_v1 and the addendum will show a 2027-01-01 effective date. DocuSign link will be included in the envelope (cc’d).

2) Audit logs: We can write logs to your S3. We will set up an audit bucket in your account and provide the IAM policy template. Egress: standard egress applies when exporting logs; we’ll include a detailed egress appendix in the SOW.

3) Proration: If you elect to accelerate the sandbox start to 2027-01-01, we will pro-rate any overlap with your existing term (BGX-2025-07). Net effect: you pay the remainder of the current term at your existing rates plus the pro-rated sandbox commitment for the 2027 calendar period. I’ll include a line-by-line proration example in the DocuSign packet.

Next steps:
- I will send DocuSign with SOW + KMS binding addendum + pricing worksheet (this afternoon).
- Marissa will queue onboarding and secure a kickoff slot week of 2027-01-10 for smoke tests.
- Kimberly and Dylan will prepare the validation runbook and reserved capacity ticket.

If PO comes within 48 hours we can meet your timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to the cutover.

Laura
